name: Dynamic Lucca Elite 2-Person Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Lucca Elite 2-Person Ultra-Low EMF (Between 3-5 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Searching for a healthier way to unwind right at home? Dynamic Saunas are built from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood, giving you a sauna that’s as durable as it is stylish. With advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels, each session surrounds you in gentle, energy-efficient warmth that helps restore balance, ease fatigue, and promote overall well-being. Whether placed in a master bath, walk-in closet, basement, or fitness room, Dynamic Saunas are designed to fit seamlessly into your lifestyle. Their compact build makes installation simple, while their long-lasting health benefits make every use an investment in daily comfort and vitality. With a Dynamic Sauna, your home becomes a private retreat for relaxation and renewal. Features: Ultra Low EMF - EMF between 3 to 5 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Full 2-person capacity Natural Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood construction Easy Removable Bench - Stretching, Exercise, or Yoga Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light feature 7 PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF 360 Carbon Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) - (Heating Panels on all 4 interior walls.) Roof vent Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth, MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 330 lbs. Shipping weight: 385 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp plug & play Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 48" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 38" x 44" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
